title: Enchanting
summary: Hypixel's enchanting - the Enchantment Table, enchanted books and the anvil, ultimate enchantments, and the Enchanting skill.

two books of the same enchantment and level make one of the next level, for free. They combine up to the table's top level (two Sharpness IV make V, but two V don't make VI); enchantments the table doesn't have combine up to their highest book.

Each enchantment's tooltip says what it does at its level. They work as on Hypixel:

rows.x: Damage (added to the Combat skill's bonus)

Sharpness, Power (bows), Smite (undead), Bane of Arthropods, Ender Slayer, Cubism (creepers and slimes), Impaling (sea mobs), Smoldering, Gravity, Dragon Hunter, First Strike (first hit), Triple Strike (first three hits), Execute, Prosecute, Giant Killer, One For All, Swarm
Protection (Defense), Growth (Health), True Protection, Big Brain, Smarty Pants (Intelligence), Sugar Rush (Speed), Rejuvenate (Health Regen)

Critical (Crit Damage), Vicious (Ferocity), Divine Gift (Magic Find), Efficiency (Mining Speed), Harvesting and Cultivating (Farming Fortune), the Turbo enchants (their crop's Fortune), Angler (Sea Creature Chance), Luck of the Sea, Expertise, Compact
Life Steal (heals 0.5% of your health a level), Syphon (heals on crits), Mana Steal, Fire Aspect, Knockback, Thunderlord (every third hit), Cleave (hits mobs around)

s.x: The others show on the item but don't do anything yet: Looting, Luck, Experience, Venomous, Lethality, most fishing and farming upgrades (Lure, Caster, Replenish...) and most ultimate enchantments. Bookshelf Power and the Enchanting level some enchants need, and the Experimentation Table, are coming.
